event_summary: A toy train travels rightward along a wooden track while the camera follows it, after an early visible change in a nearby switch-like track piece.
raw_event_description: The scene opens on a light wooden toy railway on a green textured surface with a red toy house beside a turnout area. A light-colored switch or loose track piece near the turnout is first angled diagonally and then appears farther to the right in a changed orientation. A yellow-and-red toy locomotive enters from the left on the straight track, followed by two red carriages with yellow panels. The train continues moving to the right along the wooden track, passing the red house and then traveling across a longer straight section. The camera pans or tracks right to keep the train and carriages in view. By the end, the locomotive has moved out of frame to the right and the rear carriage remains partly visible near the right edge.

reasons: The track, turnout area, green surface, and red house are visible.
The train is not yet visible in the first frame.
A switch-like or loose track piece near the turnout is visible.
